prompt: We enabled scalar quantization on our collection but RAM usage didn't decrease at all. Looking at the node-level metrics, there's still a bunch of cache memory. What went wrong?

assertions.text: Explains cache is separate from quantization savings
Explains that original vectors still get cached via memmap during rescoring
Recommends setting on_disk=True for original vectors
Warns against setting always_ram=False (causes CPU spikes)
Provides the correct pattern: quantized vectors in RAM, originals explicitly on disk
Provides working Python code for the fix
